snippet.title: Turn-Based Strategy: Demise of Nations
snippet.description:
Official trailer for Demise of Nations, a thrilling 4X turn-based grand strategy wargame covering the rise of Rome till the fall of modern civilization.

Game's website: http://www.demiseofnations.com?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=rom_trailer_aug2017
Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/338810?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=rom_trailer_aug2017

Discord: https://discord.gg/BmMcphk
